entries.label: MGS2 — Shell 1 Core / salle des otages
entries.prompt: Create ONE wide 16:9 empty static HD painted 2D fighting stage source for CQC Versus Legacy, based carefully on the attached original-game reference. Preserve each game's specific place, architecture, palette and materials. Continuous horizontal walkable fighting strip at the front. Remove every person, vehicle, HUD, scope reticle, annotation, logo and text. No collage, no spritesheet, no UI. Metal Gear Solid 2 Shell 1 Core B1 conference hall where the hostages were held. Base on the screenshot's raised brown wooden platform, small plain wooden lectern and thin standing US flag, large dark projection screen framed with rectangular dark green structural panels, and green-grey railing/side steps. Compose a straight side-on view facing this actual low presentation stage, with a wide unoccupied grey-green floor foreground, cool subdued institutional lighting and plain industrial paneled walls. This is the modest interior conference hall inside Big Shell, not the outdoor Federal Hall final duel. Preserve the reference flag hanging orientation and placement next to lectern. No audience chairs in the front fighting lane, no hostages, no soldiers, no speaker, no screen content.

notes: Location and episode checked against the listed screenshot references.
Static painted HD source; perspective, hidden surfaces and fine textures are adapted and not certified as exact 1:1.
No animation, collision layout, parallax separation or runtime admission.
Only a partial conference-platform capture was accessible; full room proportions and screen/rail geometry require comparison to a wide game capture.
